description.zh: v2.2.1（补充包）：UI 视觉层次重做（字号阶梯 / 图标 / 分隔线 / 主次按钮）+ 自动检查更新。随机上线：装成真人的 Operit AI 插件。你沉默得越久，它上线的概率就越高，会在随机时间主动来找你说话。v1.2 静默时段；v1.3 作息样本统计；v1.4 日夜静默独立开关；v1.5 内置日历与节假日；v1.6 静默逻辑反转；v1.7 学生模式与日期级静默；v1.9.1 提示词折叠分组 + A1/A2 真区别；v2.2.0 主页 UI 瘦身（y 与读数合成一张状态卡、5 张入口卡合成紧凑列表、操作行 2x2）+ 三页静默 catch 改为显示错误 + 新增「自动检查 GitHub 更新」（发现新版本时主页横幅提示，可下载更新包 / 稍后 / 跳过此版本）；v2.1.0 字段驱动重构（FIELD_SPEC 一张表管全部，新增配置只改一处；get_formula 改遍历生成、update_formula 加自动校验兜底）+ 默认提示词强化（7 项改成分点要求、去 emoji、置气/巡检更自然）；v2.0.0 正式版：话术库里的占位串 / 空内容会被自动跳过（全部不可用时回落成 AI 自己发挥），默认前缀模板加硬约束（只照着话术说、不复述内部提示）；v1.9.4 面板去 emoji 与符号、重做排版层次（标题/说明/按钮/结果块四级，一眼看懂）；v1.9.3 新增「控制台」二级页面（直调 API：掷骰一次 / 查沉默 / 进入运行态 / 设 X；全量原始读数；补上沉默阈值等以前没有入口的配置；17 工具清单与 API 文档；一键跳转提示词页）；v1.9.2 修复子页面读不到配置（参数/提示词/免打扰/日期四页读取失效，现在改为兼容返回并在读不到时明确报错）、提示词与话术框预填当前真实文案、逐项标注「何时用/占位符」、未改动的格子保存时自动跳过、主页数据每次进入都刷新；v1.9 全部提示词可自定义（8 处，含置气消息与档位话术库）、修复置气消息从未发出的问题、面板拆分为二级页面（参数/提示词/免打扰/日期）、面板配色跟随宿主主题。
description.en: On Air: an Operit AI plugin that pretends to be a real person. The longer you stay silent, the higher the chance it comes online and reaches out. v1.2 quiet periods; v1.3 schedule sample stats; v1.4 independent day/night quiet; v1.5 built-in calendar & holidays; v1.6 quiet logic reversed; v1.7 student mode & date quiet; v1.9.1 collapsible prompt groups + real A1/A2 difference; v2.2.0 slimmer home UI (merged status card, compact entry list, 2x2 actions) + non-silent error reporting on 3 pages + new GitHub update checker (in-panel banner with download / later / skip); v2.1.0 field-driven refactor (one FIELD_SPEC table; get_formula iterates, update_formula auto-validates & fills gaps) + strengthened default prompts (7 items rewritten with explicit rules, emoji removed); v2.0.0 STABLE: placeholder/empty entries in the wording library are skipped automatically (falls back to AI improvising when none are usable), and the default prefix prompt now hard-constrains the AI to only say the wording without echoing internal prompts; v1.9.4 removed emoji/symbols and rebuilt the visual hierarchy (title/desc/button/result four levels, readable at a glance); v1.9.3 new Console sub-page (call APIs directly: roll once / check silence / enter running / set X; full raw readings; newly exposed configs like the silence threshold; 17-tool list + API docs; one-tap jump to the prompts page); v1.9.2 fixed sub-pages failing to load config (all four sub-pages were broken; now tolerant parsing plus explicit error text), prompt boxes pre-filled with the current effective text and a per-item 'when it is used / placeholders' note, untouched boxes are skipped on save, home data refreshes on every entry; v1.9 all prompts customizable (8 slots incl. sulk message & tier scripts), fixed sulk message never being sent, new Prompts settings page, panel colors follow host theme.

description.zh: 空闲态每15分钟查日志判断沉默，运行态每分钟x累加+算y+掷骰发消息
